name: Highlight and pen loop
what: A word is typed in small on a paper page and grows to full size, a highlight wipes across behind it, a subtitle grows in underneath, then a hand-drawn pen loop circles both and its tail runs out to a small slanted note.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f2-f16 (00:00:00:02-00:00:00:16) the word is typed in small, letter by letter, then grows to full size at f14-f20 (00:00:00:14-00:00:00:20); f24-f56 (00:00:00:24-00:00:01:26) a highlight bar appears at its right end and wipes left behind it (fastest f30-f38); f49-f64 (00:00:01:19-00:00:02:04) the subtitle grows in word by word; f60-f84 (00:00:02:00-00:00:02:24) a pen draws a loop up the left, over the top, down the right and back under (on twos); f84-f106 (00:00:02:24-00:00:03:16) its tail runs on to the left; f108-f120 (00:00:03:18-00:00:04:00) a small slanted note pops in at the tail and settles; then it holds to f209 (00:00:06:29)
